title: A Signal for the Archive
author: Coral Vasquez
blurb: Ansel Delacroix, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
